release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.4.6 — Tactile Skeuomorphic Redesign, Real-time Parent Log & Fixed Redirection:
• Fixed Auto-Redirect Bug: Opening a restricted app displays the tactile obsidian Study Guardian overlay and stays permanently locked until the student explicitly taps 'Solve Quick MCQ to Unlock' or parent inputs PIN.
• Native Skeuomorphic Redesign: Overhauled OverlayBlocker with concentric halo rings, live floating '● FOCUS GUARDIAN ACTIVE' pill, physical 3D button shelves, and tactile calculator keypad with glowing cyan capsules.
• 0 Credit Default Balance: Starting balance is strictly 0 credits across all accounts with automated legacy balance migration.
• Real-time Parent Activity Log: In-app 0ms event dispatcher and Supabase Realtime channel stream all app blocks, quiz solves, study modes, and PIN overrides.
• Dedicated Student Guarded Apps Screen: View all restricted apps, remaining unlock windows, and parent authorizations.
• Parent App Restriction Suite: Toggle individual apps, 'Guard All' / 'Unguard All' in batch, and add custom apps or top presets (Roblox, Discord, Twitter, Netflix, etc.).
• Synchronized Focus Score: Guaranteed 1:1 mathematical parity between Student Dashboard and Analytics views.
• App-Wide Tactile Skeuomorphism: 3D button shelves, dual bevels, Apple-grade specular hairlines, and ambient box shadows.
